services.title: Towing
services.body: Vehicles and equipment are secured and moved the way the load actually calls for.

reviews.author: Keisha Brown
reviews.text: Called at 8:40pm and was at my home and vehicle dropped off before 9:30pm. I truly appreciate Anthony coming right away to get my vehicle where it needed to be after waiting over 3 hours for someone else.

reviews.author: Andrea Smith
reviews.text: I was at my wits end about finding someone knowledgeable, reliable, and good with car repairs while I am on Spring Break! My brother D, owner of D's Cutzz, suggested I go talk to Anthony of A&H Towing. I met Anthony and after explaining the issue with my car, he quickly told me what the issue was just from listening to me speak. My car arrived at the shop yesterday afternoon (4-24-2025) and the next thing I knew, Anthony was calling me letting me know that I could pick up my car!! It drives great!! Anthony reached out today (4-25-2025) to make sure my car was good. That is Awesome customer service!! I am his newest customer, and I will be recommending A&H to family and friends. Thank you again Anthony!!

reviews.author: Wayne Dowling
reviews.text: My truck broke down when passing through. Called for service and the driver was on site within minutes. Great service and reasonable price

reviews.author: Sebastian
reviews.text: Anthony really helped me out when my truck broke down and I was in a bind. Freezing outside and late at night, he showed up with that big tow truck and saved the day. Not only did he help me out with a tow, but he even recommended a great mechanic I could take it to and drop it off that late. He towed it there for me and walked me through the drop-off process. Genuinely the best guy I could've called for a tow.

reviews.author: Christa White
reviews.text: Hands down the best customer service we have ever had. Anthony found out we had been broken down since early morning and came right away. He brought his personal vehicle so we could go get something to eat. He worked on the jeep for almost two hours and the price he quoted was more than reasonable it even ended up being cheaper. The next day he texted to make sure we made it home safely. Jeep runs great and if we are ever in North Carolina and need work done we wouldn’t hesitate to texted him.

reviews.author: Sarah C
reviews.text: A & H Tire and Auto is amazing! Engine light came on, my car was running hot, and engine fan constantly ran. Had thermostat put on elsewhere, still same problem. Called A & H, he towed and fixed my car. Issue resolved! Great customer service and awesome work! I have no complaints. He is now my go-to mechanic. Highly recommend A & H!

reviews.author: KRISTIE JEFFERIES
reviews.text: A & H provided wonderful service to us when my son had a car accident. Even though the accident happened in another city A & H was quick to the scene! They were patient and understanding when they had to follow me to another location to get the payment for my son's towing. As a single parent, it's always a relief to know someone will be there when your child is in need and A & H was right there!!! Thank you A & H!!! We appreciate you! I highly recommend this company for your emergency needs.

reviews.author: Morgan Hilhorst
reviews.text: My car broke down in Wendell and he was so quick and responsive. He texted me updates and pictures all along the way including picking up and dropping off the car. Good prices and great service!

reviews.author: Shakeya Braswell
reviews.text: Skilled, reliable, and honest, a mechanic who treats every car like it’s his own. Quick hands, sharp mind, and work you can trust every time.

reviews.author: Bertha Spruill
reviews.text: I had a very pleasant experience with this company. They came and got us from mile marker 459 near Nashville NC and had us back on the road in a timely manner. I recommend them and there services to any one. Thanks A & H Towing!!

reviews.author: Amy Gustavson
reviews.text: Excellent tire change on short notice. Found them when we got a flat tire on I-95. Their time estimate to arrive was spot on. We really appreciate how dependable they were! Thank you!

reviews.author: Glenda Conrad
reviews.text: I am so grateful for A & H Tire and Auto. My children were traveling back to PA from SC and broke down. The owner worked with me and quickly and safely picked them up. I would recommend these angels to anyone!! Thank you again!!

reviews.author: Latwuan Dozier
reviews.text: I received help immediately. The owner was very helpful and straightforward. Honest and a clen work environment. I recommend A & H Tire and Auto to anyone in need of service

reviews.author: Matt Haines
reviews.text: Great driver and EXTREMELY experienced!!!!!!!!!! I’ve been worried about most tow drivers damaging my cars. Not with Anthony!! Made a complicated tow, very quick and I was NEVER nervous about him damaging my vintage BMW. Thanks!

reviews.author: Betty Freshwater
reviews.text: They came to my aid within minutes and was very helpful to my family and reasonable. Thank you for such outstanding service very professional.

reviews.author: Tia Alston
reviews.text: I was very pleased with the professionalism, afforability, courtsey and excellent repair job that was done on both of my vehicles. I would absolutely refer my family and friends to this repair shop.

reviews.author: Brad Lanto
reviews.text: Outstanding service! Towed car at 8 pm and fixed it within two hours so I could get back on the road. Great customer service!

reviews.author: Nyashia Lee
reviews.text: I called him late Christmas night and he still was all in for helping. He was so nice and patient with me. Very professional!

reviews.author: Daryl Long
reviews.text: Very knowledgeable. I take all of my vehicles here to be serviced. I refer all of my friends and most of them have made him their go to mechanic.

reviews.author: Shanice Renee
reviews.text: Worst towing company ever! They don't answer the phones and claim to be 24 hours but nobody showed up to come tow my car

reviews.author: Coby
reviews.text: They were punctual on their arrival time & reasonable with their towing fees; they work with AAA. GREAT!!

reviews.author: M Arrington
reviews.text: I would not recommend this tow company. After towing my vehicle, they left it sitting on the wrecker in an area that wasn’t fenced or secured. When I expressed my concerns, I was simply told they had cameras, as if that was supposed to make me feel comfortable. Cameras don’t prevent theft, vandalism, or damage they only record it after it happens. When you’re trusting a company with your vehicle, you expect it to be stored in a secure location. I was disappointed by both the lack of security and the dismissive response to my concerns. I hope they take customer concerns more seriously and improve how they protect the vehicles entrusted to them.
